resources.string:
Your Pantry is Empty! 

Add your leftover ingredients to find out what you can cook right now. 

Note: No need to log these four staples (salt, sugar, black pepper, or water), we already assume you have these on hand!

- Spelling: Use common singular or plural names (such as chicken, onions, or tomato) so recipes can match accurately. 
- Units: Pick the matching unit for your item. Need Imperial (oz/lb) or Metric (g/ml)? Switch anytime in Settings! 
- Expiry Date: Setting an expiry date is optional, leave it blank if you prefer. 
- The 4 Staples: You do not need to add salt, sugar, black pepper, or water, we always assume you have these on hand.

- Quantity: Adjust the remaining amount after cooking to keep your recipe suggestions accurate. 
- Name & Unit: Correct any spelling or switch units if needed. Change your preferred unit system anytime in Settings. 
- Expiry Date: Tap "Set Expiry Date" to update or push back the date as needed. 
- Removing Items: To completely remove an ingredient, tap the trash can icon on the pantry screen.
No recipes match your pantry yet, add more ingredients!
Tip: Once you have cooked this recipe, remember to update your pantry quantities in the My Pantry tab so your stock remains accurate!
